Olivia: Quick sync request — we need to lock timelines for Snowflake + Qdrant pilot, Databricks delta-sharing sample, and a marketplace listing. Can we do a coordinated partner preview and a public marketplace launch 2 weeks later?
Rajat: Connector PR is merged to repo/partners/qd-snow. Need Snowflake schema approval and a migration note. Perf tests look good except embedding throughput.
Maya: For the Databricks side, customers asked for a delta-sharing example and a notebook. I can draft the notebook but need an auth snippet and a sample table. Can eng provide creds and a tiny dataset?
Tom: Marketing preference is a partner-preview the week of Apr 6, public marketplace listing Apr 20. Is that timeline realistic from engineering + legal?
Eoin: FYI I spoke with Snowflake PM — they'll require a joint comms review + logo usage signoff. That adds ~3 business days. Also they want a partner-run webinar within 30 days of listing.
Rajat: On the engineering blockers: embedding path needs batching knob tuned for Qdrant. Current batch_size=16; at production loads we should target 64. Also the connector needs a small config change for Snowflake VARIANT handling. Patch attached.
Olivia: Thanks — can you drop the patch in a pre-release and tag partner-preview? I'll coordinate with Snowflake and Qdrant to get legal signoff.
IntegrationBot: DeployBot: canary deploy queued for partner-preview cluster at 2026-04-02T22:00Z — image: partners/connector:v0.9-rc — status: queued
Rajat: Quick command to run local perf (linux):
```
python -m perf_runner --model embeddings --batch 64 --db qdrant --workers 8
```
Logs look like:
```
[INFO] batch=64 throughput=1200/s median=45ms p95=110ms
```
Maya: I'll start the Databricks notebook and link it in the repo. Can product provide the copy for the marketplace tile (short blurb + bullets)?
Tom: I'll draft marketplace copy and a short partner case study blurb. Want to highlight: low-latency embeddings via dedicated routing, delta-sharing sample, and single-click marketplace deploy.
Olivia: Action items:
- Rajat: submit partner-preview artifact + merge migration note (due 2026-03-29)
- Eoin: start legal/comms thread with Snowflake & Qdrant (due 2026-03-30)
- Maya: Databricks notebook + sample dataset PR (due 2026-03-31)
- Tom: marketplace copy + webinar draft (due 2026-04-01)
I'll schedule a 15m sync tomorrow. Ping here if dates slip. :thumbsup:
Rajat: ACK — will push patch and tag v0.9-rc today.
Eoin: I'll loop in Snowflake legal and add a calendar hold.
IntegrationBot: DeployBot: partner-preview deploy started — status: in_progress
Olivia: Great progress — thanks team. Let's keep threads concise in this channel; we'll use the calendar invite for the live sync.
